summary: Feed s142_double is degraded: NDR 10G port is severely overloaded by microbursts to 29.95 Gbps (299% capacity) risking drops, and 94.3% encrypted traffic exceeds 90% tolerance limiting payload inspection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating multiple sources onto a single 10 Gbps NDR port without load balancing. 1ms microbursts peak at 29.95 Gbps (299% of port capacity, 2.995x vs 0.8 threshold), overwhelming ingress buffers.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR drops packets during bursts, causing incomplete flows and missed signatures/behavioral detections. NDR needs both directions and full payload, so drops create blind spots and false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic flow-aware across 3x10G NDR cluster members to keep per-port peaks <80% and preserve bidirectional flow integrity, eliminating burst drops.

findings.root_cause: 94.35% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) vs 90% NDR tolerance. Traffic arrives encrypted at the packet broker with no prior decryption point in the visibility path.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for detection but is blind to 94% of payloads; limited to metadata/JA3/handshake analysis, missing exploits, C2 and exfiltration inside encrypted streams.

params.policy: selective decrypt with privacy bypass, send decrypted copy to NDR

recommended_fix.why: Restores cleartext payload visibility for NDR analysis while maintaining compliance via selective decryption; addresses root cause that broker cannot inspect encrypted bytes.
